title: Insights into trichogramma chilonis olfactory signalling: molecular cloning and  expression profiling of pheromone binding proteins.
author: Shubha G M
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Rear insects on host eggs
steps.instruction: Mass‑rear Trichogramma chilonis on Corcyra cephalonica eggs under standard rearing conditions.

steps.title: Isolate total RNA
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from the reared T. chilonis specimens using an appropriate RNA isolation kit or phenol‑chloroform method.

steps.title: Purify mRNA
steps.instruction: Purify messenger RNA from the total RNA preparation using poly‑A selection or an mRNA purification kit.

steps.title: Amplify PBP gene
steps.instruction: Perform PCR with gene‑specific primers to amplify the pheromone‑binding protein (PBP) gene from the purified mRNA‑derived cDNA.

steps.title: Clone into TA vector
steps.instruction: Ligate the PCR product into a TA cloning vector (e.g., pGEM‑T) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Transform DH5α cells
steps.instruction: Introduce the ligation mixture into chemically competent DH5α E. coli cells and plate on selective agar.

steps.title: Screen colonies by PCR
steps.instruction: Perform colony PCR on transformants to identify clones carrying the PBP insert.

steps.title: Confirm insert by sequencing
steps.instruction: Isolate plasmid DNA from positive colonies, release the insert by restriction digestion, and submit for Sanger sequencing to verify the gene sequence.

steps.title: Codon‑optimize gene
steps.instruction: Use bioinformatic tools to codon‑optimize the full‑length PBP gene for expression in E. coli.

steps.title: Synthesize optimized gene
steps.instruction: Order the synthetic, codon‑optimized gene from a commercial gene synthesis service.

steps.title: Clone into pET28a‑SUMO
steps.instruction: Insert the synthetic gene into the pET28a‑SUMO expression vector using the appropriate restriction sites and ligation conditions.

steps.title: Transform BL21 cells
steps.instruction: Introduce the recombinant pET28a‑SUMO construct into competent BL21 E. coli cells and plate on selective medium.

steps.title: Verify BL21 clones
steps.instruction: Conduct colony PCR on BL21 transformants to confirm presence of the expression construct.

steps.title: Express recombinant protein
steps.instruction: Induce protein expression in positive BL21 clones under appropriate conditions (e.g., IPTG induction).

steps.title: Purify expressed protein
steps.instruction: Harvest cells and purify the recombinant protein using affinity chromatography compatible with the His‑SUMO tag.

steps.title: Analyze by SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Run purified protein samples on SDS‑PAGE to assess purity and molecular weight.

steps.title: Validate by western blot
steps.instruction: Perform western blotting using an anti‑His or specific antibody to confirm protein expression.

steps.title: Record sequencing output
steps.instruction: Document that Illumina paired‑end sequencing generated 18,372,639 high‑quality reads, which were de novo assembled into 24,488 transcripts.
